section.15: The Chapters On Judgements From The Messenger of Allah

15.name_native: The Chapters On Judgements From The Messenger of Allah

hadiths.text: Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that during a Khutbah, the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"The proof is due from the claimant, and the oath is due from the one the claim is made against
